tucson-az:
Zero of 25 sampled Tucson apartment sites run RealPage, while 12 run Yardi (e.g. https://tucsonlanding.securecafe.com/) and 2 run Entrata (https://liveari.residentportal.com/auth): the market is open but held by rivals.
It is still growing: 1,106 new units in 5+ unit buildings permitted in the last 12 months against 152,892 renter households (Census BPS + ACS 2024).
Buildings are changing hands in 2026 (https://www.costar.com/article/874468469/bascom-group-acquires-289-unit-apartment-complex-in-tucson-arizona, https://www.multihousingnews.com/bascom-arizona-ventures-buys-tucson-community-for-53m/), and new owners often re-pick software; no local portal complaints were found, so the pain case rests on the Yardi share.
